purpose: Measure whole public Room.frame calls without serializing operation telemetry during live play.
operation_population: Same clock, classifications and limits as plan.json. Retain all bootstrap, error, replacement, pump, normal and repair rows without subtraction.
storage: At most 65536 rows in an SDK-metered allocation. Capacity exhaustion fails the run. The default game has no allocation; profile=1 keeps periodic output.
emission: Emit one SAMPLE_OPERATION_END before closing Room/Session. After successful Room/Session close, emit every stored row in sequence, then release the allocation before checked final resource statistics.
presentation: Retain all raw requestAnimationFrame intervals. Assess intervals ending no later than the browser-observed SAMPLE_OPERATION_END. Report the retained teardown interval count separately.
duration: Measure first GO to SAMPLE_OPERATION_END, before teardown serialization. Buffered emission time is never counted as play time.
admission: All contract.json thresholds remain unchanged. A short case checks instrumentation and ownership only; sustained admission still requires at least 600 seconds and the declared sample counts.
